name: A11 Chat Smoke Test
description: Après édition d'un fichier chat/route, teste que le endpoint /api/chat répond

then.command: powershell -Command "try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/chat' -Method POST -ContentType 'application/json' -Body '{\"message\":\"ping\"}' -TimeoutSec 10 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host \"Chat: $($r.StatusCode)\" } catch { Write-Host \"Chat: $($_.Exception.Message)\" }"
